evals.prompt: merge contract.pdf, signature.jpg and appendix.pdf into one pdf
evals.expected_output: Runs pdf_merge.py once with the three files in that order and an output named contract-merged.pdf beside them, then reports the output path and the page total.

evals.prompt: turn all the screenshots in ./shots into a single PDF
evals.expected_output: Lists ./shots first, passes the folder so pages follow name order with numbers in order, writes shots-merged.pdf outside the folder, and reports the page total, any files it skipped, and the shrink factor if it printed one.

evals.prompt: compile everything under .screenshots/run-1/ into one pdf, desktop first then mobile
evals.expected_output: Lists the tree, sees that each page folder holds desktop.pdf and mobile.pdf beside desktop/ and mobile/ folders of the same PNGs, merges one set instead of both (asking which if the request does not settle it), passes every desktop input before every mobile one in page-folder order, and reports the output path and page total.

evals.prompt: combine scan.pdf and IMG_2041.HEIC into one file
evals.expected_output: Says HEIC is not read, converts it to JPEG first (sips on macOS) or asks for a JPEG, then merges scan.pdf and the converted image in that order and reports the result.
